description: The Brand tab: the kit's colors and logos that generated video graphics use. The server runs these inside a Chirpy turn through the same operations the Brand controls call.

actions.description: Change the kit's colors (at most 8, first is primary): set replaces them all, add appends, remove drops, primary moves one color to the front.
Make a saved logo the kit's primary logo.
Delete a saved logo and its file. The creator is asked to confirm first.

colors.description: Hex codes (#FF7A21) or exact CSS color names. primary takes one color.
